rules.title: Late fee is charged once per instalment
rules.statement: After the grace period, the first day an instalment is overdue, a fee is charged: the greater of the flat fee and a percentage of the overdue amount, limited to the cap, plus 18% GST. It is charged once per instalment.

rules.title: Penal interest stops at NPA
rules.statement: Each overdue day, penal interest is charged on the unpaid principal and interest of each overdue instalment. Once the loan is classified NPA, no further penal interest is charged.
rules.notes: Penal interest always uses a 365-day year.

rules.title: Days past due count from the contractual due date
rules.statement: Days past due run from the original due date of the oldest unpaid billed instalment. The class is STANDARD at 0 days, SMA0 up to 30, SMA1 up to 60, SMA2 up to the product's NPA limit (default 90), then NPA.

contradictions.description: A comment says penal interest compounds monthly on the penal balance. The code charges penal interest only on unpaid principal and interest and never on the accrued penal balance.

open_questions: When the loan closes, accrued interest for the final period is written off. Is that intended for every closure or only for foreclosure?
